notes.title: New version planned
notes.notes:
[h2]New version planned:[/h2]
[b] Open-air cinema: [/b] Increase the labor enthusiasm of workers and peasants and have higher production efficiency.
[b] Health center: [/b] It is mainly composed of villagers who are half-doctors and half-farmers to ensure the strong health of the villagers.
[b] Time-limited missions: [/b] Combine historical facts to add more colorful story content
[b] Propaganda Pictorial: [/b] Different pictorial magazines have different Buff mechanisms, and the production unit sticks it to stimulate the villagers' enthusiasm for work.
[b] Dynamic characters: [/b] Add dynamic villains to the scene to make the picture rich and full.
If players have more interesting ways to play, welcome to write to the author, will definitely actively adopt, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Game launch announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your attention and support, this work will be officially launched on July 7, 2023, please stay tuned.
During this period, the author will continue to optimize and improve the version, find and modify various bugs in time, if you are interested players can join our discussion group, give various suggestions and opinions, will definitely listen carefully, thank you.

Welcome to join the official E-Mail: adongblog@msn.com
